topics.title: Opus Audio Codec & Frame Sizing
topics.objective: Configure Opus speech and music encoding with 10ms - 20ms frame sizes for optimal packet efficiency.
topics.exercise: Encode raw 48kHz PCM audio into Opus frames and measure compression ratio and encoding latency.

topics.title: Adaptive Jitter Buffering & Packet Loss Concealment (PLC)
topics.objective: Smooth network packet arrival variance without introducing excessive end-to-end audio lag.
topics.exercise: Implement an adaptive jitter buffer adjusting buffer delay dynamically between 20ms and 80ms based on ping RTT.

topics.title: WebRTC Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU) Routing
topics.objective: Forward audio RTP packets across hundreds of concurrent listeners without expensive server-side transcode re-encoding.
topics.exercise: Build a multi-participant audio stage where a speaker's audio stream is forwarded to 50 active subscribers.

topics.title: Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC) & Noise Suppression
topics.objective: Filter speaker feedback and ambient background noise using WebRTC Audio Processing Module (APM).
topics.exercise: Configure an audio pre-processing pipeline eliminating acoustic speaker feedback during live calls.

topics.title: Audio QoS Metrics: Packet Loss, RTT & MOS Scoring
topics.objective: Calculate Mean Opinion Score (MOS) in real time to monitor listener voice quality degradations.
topics.exercise: Write an audio telemetry collector logging MOS scores and automatically switching to lower bitrates on packet loss.
